Reference / async/cancellation

async/cancellation#

Explicit cooperative cancellation capabilities.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let cancellation = Cancellation();
let token = cancellation.cancelling();

for records -> record {
    token.check();
    process(record);
}

cancellation.cancel();

Description#

Explicit cooperative cancellation capabilities.

Cancellation owns one runtime-local cancellation request. Its cancelling() action returns a restricted Cancelling capability which can observe the request but cannot issue it.

Explicit cancellation is independent from Future.cancel(). Requesting a Cancellation does not cancel any future automatically: cooperating code must call check() or await wait().

Cpu-bound cooperation.

Pass the restricted capability to work which should remain cancellable:

check() is cheap before a request and throws the builtin Cancelled afterwards.

Waiting for a request.

wait() is useful when cancellation itself is an asynchronous event:

async monitor(cancelling is Cancelling) {
    await cancelling.wait();
    audit.writeln("cancellation requested");
}

let cancellation = Cancellation();
let monitoring = spawn Monitor(
    cancelling: cancellation.cancelling(),
).run();
cancellation.cancel();
await monitoring;

Every waiter resumes exactly once. A wait started after the request completes immediately. Cancelling the future returned by wait() only abandons that wait; it does not request cancellation and does not affect other waiters.

Ownership.

Keep Cancellation with the owner of an operation and pass only Cancelling to collaborators. Constructing CancellationToken directly is rejected by the runtime; tokens can only come from cancelling().
